data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 36.123 million, representing a 37.40% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release is primarily attributed to the overall 'Change in prior year provisions' as detailed in the technical provisions note. While the report notes adverse impacts from COVID-19 losses, sizeable hurricane losses, and back year deterioration in the Casualty market, the overall prior year movement was a release. The claims development triangle shows a different picture, which might be due to the Part VII transfer.
raw_causal_phrases: The global Corona virus pandemic has adversely impacted the Syndicate result with net losses totalling GBP 57.3m.
The increase in the net claims loss ratio in 2020 to 127.1% (2019: 85.0%) is largely due to COVID-19 losses.
poor performance in the Property market as a result of sizeable hurricane losses
back year deterioration seen in the Casualty market
significant large losses in the market
Covid-19 reserves account for approximately one third on the net reserves at 31 December 2020.
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 18 shows a significant strengthening for prior years (+GBP 58.423m), which contradicts the explicit gross prior year release of -GBP 36.123m stated in Note 16. This discrepancy may be due to distortions from the Part VII transfer and subsequent 100% reinsurance back, as described in Note 21, which states 'no economic impact' and 'no net impact on the balance sheet' but could affect gross figures in the triangle. The figure from Note 16 'Change in prior year provisions' is used as the primary source for prior year development. The exact_reserve_text is a line item from a table, as no explicit narrative sentence describing the prior year reserve movement was found.
